text: From the 1950s until 1973, West Germany invited workers (Gastarbeiter) from Italy, Spain, Greece, Turkey and other countries. Many stayed and their families are now in the second, third or fourth generation. Today nearly three in ten people in Germany have a migration background.
You will hear stories like this in German classes, and it is a polite way to start a conversation: Woher kommt Ihre Familie ursprünglich?
